release_notes: PERFORMANCE: Large batch exports now reuse scene and chapter snapshots, reduce repeated material and Maya scene queries, and run inside one safe FBX, viewport, and undo session. Separate HP export combines regular non-ZBrush meshes per subgroup before smoothing and serialization, while ZBrush meshes remain separate and are not smoothed. Added safe fallback behavior and Maya 2024/2027 FBX round-trip coverage.
